title: Plan Production Hardening
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Plan Production Hardening.
learning_objectives: Explain plan production hardening using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for plan production hardening
Assess failure and operational limits of plan production hardening
concepts_covered: Production systems need role-scoped access, key rotation/recovery, audit integrity, encrypted backups, rate limiting, and protected transport.
SecretStore.set writes encrypted envelopes to a local JSON store; the README limits this sample to one API token and no key rotation.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
